question: Is there an open SCF RFP for developer tooling or indexing infrastructure I could build against?

golden.answer:
No, per the official SCF RFP Track page as of 2026-11-02. The page lists no open brief. It says "October 2026: New Q4 RFPs are coming soon." A 2026-10-16 handbook edit removed the two Q3 briefs, LayerZero DVN and x402 Facilitator with Bazaar. SCF #45 awarded teams under both. Scout still marks those two Q3 briefs open and returns one synthetic `scf-round-46` row; that is a source lag. An RFP Track submission must address an open brief from the current quarter. Applicants start with the rolling interest form. They submit a full proposal only if invited. As of 2026-11-02, #46 accepts submissions through 2026-11-09. An open brief does not guarantee eligibility or an invitation.

The dated example is illustrative. A later answer must report the roster and round state supported then.
